analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($97.71) vs SMA5/20/50 ($92.38/$90.09/$89.11): Above short/mid-term trends, confirming bullish position.
· Above SMA100/200 ($90.71/$80.19) by 7.0%/21.85%, maintaining mid-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (92.2%) + Current price approaching 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (66.5→67.4): Continues into overbought territory, confirming neutral zone hold.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.8301→0.8301): Improvement maintained, entering bullish expansion phase.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $95.35): Breaking upper band, band width at 11.68% indicating expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($88.30): Based on SMA50, distant from current price.
· Swing resistance ($99.64): Approaching 5-day high, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Recovery continues, strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.89x): Below average volume, suggesting potential weakening of upward momentum.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Entry for buy, short-term overbought caution.
